title: Fig and the Seed
note: b414 — Phase 3 complete (Learning) — air, ure, er added.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar peering into a round wooden tub, spotting a small brown seed inside.
Close view of the small brown seed resting in dark soil inside the tub.
Fig the caterpillar sitting beside the wooden tub, waiting patiently.
A thin white root just visible pushing up through the dark soil in the tub.
A small green shoot poking up out of the soil in the tub.
The green shoot grown taller, with Fig beside the tub for size comparison.
A small round bud sitting on top of the tall green shoot.
Fig the caterpillar sitting beside the wooden tub next to the tall green shoot.
